pricing_payments_desc: Payment system integration and order automation for an existing website or bot.
pricing_support_desc: If you need ongoing edits, content updates or feature tweaks after launch, I offer monthly support — fixes, updates and quick turnaround for existing clients.
pricing_note_prepay_desc: I work on a 50% upfront prepayment of the project cost. If a client backs out of the finished product, the prepayment is non-refundable, since significant time and resources have already been spent on development.
pricing_note_custom_desc: The prices shown are starting points. Before work begins, we agree the feature scope, timeline, revision rounds and final estimate.
pricing_scope: The starting price is suitable for a small project. Integrations, custom logic, hosting and ongoing support are estimated after a short brief.
pricing_scripts_desc: A custom Python script, automation, API integration or CLI tool built around your task.
pricing_cta_title: Describe the task — I’ll shape an exact estimate.
service_bots_desc: Product catalogs with photos and prices, cart and checkout, admin panel for assortment management, new order notifications and payment integrations — for your business format.
service_sites_desc: Single-page websites with thoughtful structure, smooth animations and transitions. From hero section to contact form — every block works towards a clear goal.
service_payments_desc: I connect payment acceptance (Stripe, PayPal, WayForPay) to your existing website or Telegram bot and set up automatic order routing to a CRM or chat — no manual processing needed.
service_scripts_desc: Automation for repetitive tasks, parsers, converters, generators, API integrations and small CLI tools — shaped around your workflow.
services_cta_title: Tell me what you want to automate.
value_title: What this means for your business
value_item1: The bot accepts and processes orders even at night — clients don't wait for you to open the chat.
value_item2: I optimise page weight and loading so visitors see the important information sooner and do not wait unnecessarily.
value_item3: Lead and order notifications arrive in your chosen messenger, helping you respond to clients sooner.
value_item4: Languages on one site (UA / RU / EN) — you don't lose local clients or tourists.
case_floressa_desc: Bot with catalog of flower compositions, cart and checkout directly in chat. Separate admin panel allows the shop owner to add, hide and remove products independently — without my involvement.
case_floressa_highlight: Project feature: when adding a new product through the admin panel, the bot automatically publishes a beautifully formatted post with this product in the shop's Telegram channel — with a link to purchase directly in the bot.
case_floressa_result: Result: orders no longer get lost in DMs — the bot guides the client from catalog to payment, leaving the owner to just put the bouquet together.
case_floressa_testimonial: Good afternoon, we tested it, everything worked out and got better. Thank you.
case_wave_desc: Single-page website for a craft bar: atmospheric presentation, menu with prices, order form, guest reviews and map — all sections needed for a venue so a person scrolls through to table reservation.
case_wave_highlight: Project feature: UA / RU / EN switcher right on the hero section — the site works equally well for local guests and tourists, without separate language versions.
case_wave_result: Result: the site loads in under 2 seconds and reads equally well to locals and tourists — no need to run three separate sites for three languages.
case_wave_feature3: Order form with delivery and pickup
case_modulehouse_kicker: Turnkey catalog for modular houses, saunas and offices
case_modulehouse_desc: A catalog website for an Odesa-based company that manufactures and installs reinforced-concrete modular houses, saunas, garages and offices. The showcase presents ready solutions with prices, purchase steps and delivery — from picking a module to on-site installation in 14 days.
case_modulehouse_highlight: Project feature: a fully working catalog with filtering by building type (houses, offices, garages, saunas) — buyers instantly find the right option and see the price in hryvnia, without a single extra click.
case_modulehouse_result: Result: buyers find the right house and see the price in hryvnia within a couple of clicks — no calls needed to ask "so how much does it cost".
case_modulehouse_feature1: Catalog with filters by building type
case_modulehouse_feature2: Product cards with prices and a NEW status
case_modulehouse_feature3: Gallery of production and installation shots
case_modulehouse_feature4: Advantages block: 3 m ceilings, extra insulation, 100+ year lifespan
case_modulehouse_feature6: Fast contact: Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, Instagram
